concerns.text: User Story US‑2 (Preprocess the raw dataset) depends on the output of US‑1 (Download data). According to the ordering lens, each US block must be independently shippable; tasks within a US should be executable end‑to‑end without requiring artifacts produced by a different US. The current linear dependency chain violates this requirement.

User Story US‑3 (Generate visual‑layout latents) depends on US‑2, and similarly all subsequent US blocks (US‑4 through US‑13) form a sequential pipeline rather than independent units, breaching the spec‑kit precedent that each story be testable in isolation.
